reason: The document-upload and reminder automation would genuinely save my team hours, and 2,400 plus 140 a month is nothing against what we bill. But I would be putting my clients' dossiers and my intake flow on a 12-month contract with one man who does this after his day job; if he gets a better offer or burns out, I am the one explaining to 50 clients why the upload link is dead.
objection: He is a database developer by day with 10-12 hours a week for this. Who answers when something breaks on the Friday before a call deadline, and who takes over if he stops?
would_change_my_mind: A second named person behind the business, or the automations built on an account I own (my own Microsoft 365 / n8n / whatever) with a written handover so that if ILLUSTRUS disappears tomorrow everything keeps running without him.
